comparison.objective: Run a press using continuous two-hand controls, then remove the finished part; candidate tunes an isolated damper and cycles it from a guarded control.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained simultaneous button holding and post-cycle retrieval versus hex-key engagement, collar adjustment, relocking, and diagnostic iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Both controls held throughout closing stroke before part removal; body lacks numeric timing/pose thresholds and no spec version is indexed.
comparison.reason: Physical control actuation is shared, but it is central two-hand safeguarding here and only one step in the candidate; the principal tested abilities differ.
